_comment: Synthetic local-repository graph packet for issue #876. Every path, symbol
and relationship is invented against a generic public example tree; this is
not an export of any indexed repository and it does not establish that any
graph package produces this shape. It exercises the extension point only:
repository-kind evidence with file/line citations, extracted vs inferred
confidence, explicit truncation, and revision binding a consumer can score.

documents.text: Callers of parse_config: loader.load reads the parsed mapping directly.
Related tests: the config suite covers parse_config's error branch.
Blast radius beyond the first two hops was not expanded within the budget.
